name: Vision Quest — "If X is 4 or greater, it gains haste" follows the X value
notes: Sweep cast-condition leftovers (2026-10-06). "… put it onto the battlefield … If X is 4 or greater, it gains haste until end of turn." produced nothing. The sentence now moves to a branch line whose condition is the comparison itself ("[4 is 4 or greater]", true or false once X is substituted; false with no X), and "it" is the card just put onto the battlefield, picked on the board. X = 4 on Ornithopter: haste. X = 3 on Phyrexian Walker: none.
